title: Chhapra Wali Siwan Wali
desc: Anjana Singh stars as a determined Jethani who navigates family dynamics while pursuing education, alongside Sanjana Pandey, her Devrani, who's already a teacher. Family bonds shine through!

title: Piyari
desc: Two orphaned youths, Ram and Shyam, face countless challenges while striving to earn an honest living. Amid love, betrayal and family bonds, they fight to build a better future.

title: Badi Maa Chhoti Maa
desc: Badi Maa Chhoti Maa is a contemporary Bhojpuri movie starring Sanjana Pandey and Shubhi Sharma, focusing on themes around motherhood.

title: Bahu Rani Saas Maharani
desc: Explores the ups and downs of family dynamics, focusing on a mother-in-law and daughter-in-law who navigate challenges and find unexpected support in each other.

title: Mai Bina Naihar Suna
desc: In this gripping drama, characters navigate complex emotions and relationships, revealing the raw truths of life. A compelling exploration of love, loss, and the quest for connection unfolds.

title: Cycle Wali Didi
desc: A woman becomes a teacher and rides a bicycle, defying village norms. Her courage sparks outrage and admiration as she fights for education, independence, and respect in her community.
